# Tooltip

A short label that describes a control on focus or hover.

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- To add a brief description to an icon button.

## When not to

- For essential information: put it in the page.
- For interactive content: use Popover.
- On touch-only features: hover doesn't exist there.

## Examples

### On an icon button

Shown on keyboard focus or after hovering; Esc hides it. The icon button already has a name: the tooltip adds a short description.

```tsx
<div className="flex h-24 items-end">
  <Tooltip content="Cierra el panel y descarta los cambios">
    <IconButton Icon={IconClose} label="Cerrar" variant="outline" />
  </Tooltip>
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` (required) | `string` |  | The text. Short, and never the only place a fact appears: touch and some screen readers will not show it. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactElement<Record<string, unknown>>` |  | The one control it describes. It receives `aria-describedby`. |
| `placement` | `Placement` | `'top'` |  |
| `delay` | `number` | `400` | Milliseconds before it shows on hover. Focus shows it at once. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **Pattern:** `role="tooltip"` linked with `aria-describedby`, so it is read as a description.
- It shows on keyboard focus and after a short hover delay; Esc hides it; the pointer can move onto it (WCAG 1.4.13).
- It never holds links or buttons.

## Content

- One short sentence, no full stop needed.
